title: OCC 2026 — official GPX from the HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc race page
publisher: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc / UTMB World Series
claims: The official OCC race page exposes a direct GPX link under pdf.utmb.world; a HEAD request on 2026-11-20 returned HTTP 200 with 831,287 bytes.
The GPX metadata names the track OCC 2026, credits LiveTrail as creator and carries a LiveTrail copyright line but no redistribution licence.
The file contains 5,118 track points; a local planar calculation gives 60.14 km, with a 3 m elevation threshold giving +3,342 m and −3,221 m between 893 m and 2,311 m.
The GPX's 60.14 km sits between the official page header's 60 km and the official timing table's 61.4 km, while its 3 m-threshold gain matches the table's +3,342 m.

verification.checkedVia: official race page HTML + direct GPX download
verification.note: Direct URL extracted from https://montblanc.utmb.world/races/occ; file downloaded once to a temporary directory, measured locally, then deleted. The file carries a LiveTrail copyright line and no reuse grant.
